title: data-plane-traffic-shield-and-rollback-harness
creator: Maya Patel
description: Implement a rollout automation that uses traffic-shielding (sidecar-level request fencing), incremental traffic gating by tenant slice, and automated rollback heuristics for private VPC data-plane runtime upgrades. Includes Terraform module changes, preflight health checks, synthetic probe harness, and a runbook for operator-driven failures.
comments: 2026-02-16 Maya Patel: Initial spec drafted; outlined traffic-shield sidecar, Terraform module for 'shield' resources (aws_lb_target_group tags, SG rules), and synthetic probe types (liveness, kv-consistency, cold-start). Linking design doc.

2026-02-20 Lucas Chen: Spike completed for probe harness. Implemented /healthz, /kv-check and /primed-status endpoints. Local e2e with dockerized runtime passes basic flows. Pushed branch: feature/eng/traffic-shield-probes.

2026-02-25 Maya Patel: Terraform module proposal added: variables for slice_size, probe_schedule, drain_timeout. Calling out need for provider-level rate-limit allowances when creating many targets during phased traffic shifts.

2026-03-01 QA: Canary run (10% tenant slice) in staging for 60m. Observed 99th latency +8% during priming; KV-cache miss spike that subsided in 45s. No errors surfaced. Recording metrics to: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/upgrade-canaary/staging

2026-03-04 Lucas Chen: Added automated rollback heuristics: if error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 3 minutes OR 99p latency degrades > 40% relative to baseline for 5 minutes, trigger immediate 100% traffic retreat to previous binary and reattach warm cache replicas. Implemented as step function workflow with terraform toggle.

2026-03-07 Ops: Simulated partial failure by injecting latency into one AZ. Rollback logic correctly moved 30% of routed tenants off new nodes and then executed full retreat after threshold. Need to tune 'probationary_traffic' window and add rate-limited retry backoffs.

2026-03-10 Lucas Chen: PR 2248 opened with Terraform module and step-function workflow. Requesting design review and security signoff. Next: integrate KMS key rotation hook, finalize runbook, and add synthetic smoke probe to Console dashboards.
notes: Key trade-offs: tight gating reduces blast radius but increases rollout time for large fleets. We prefer conservative defaults (slice_size=5%) with an operator override for emergency fast-tracks. Terraform state operations will be serialized per-tenant-slice to avoid concurrent drift.
qa_checklist: staged canary in two staging clusters
next_steps: finalize release notes and console UX for rollout status
